Análise cluster depart

2025-08-23

load("T2/T2/clustering_depart/bfd_depart_final.RData")
df <- bfd_depart_final
table(df$clusters)
## 
##      1      2      3      4 
##  63629 209585 112712 202664
analise.numericas <- df %>% group_by(clusters) %>% 
  summarise(mean_delay_depart = mean(delay_depart),
            mean_depart_air_temperature = mean(depart_air_temperature),
            mean_depart_dew_point = mean(depart_dew_point),
            mean_depart_relative_humidity = mean(depart_relative_humidity),
            mean_depart_wind_direction = mean(depart_wind_direction),
            mean_depart_pressure = mean(depart_pressure),
            mean_depart_visibility = mean(depart_visibility),
            mean_depart_apparent_temperature = mean(depart_apparent_temperature),
            )
ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(clusters), y = delay_depart, fill = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Distribuição do Atraso na Partida por Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Atraso na Partida (minutos)")

ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(clusters), y = depart_relative_humidity, fill = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Distribuição da humidade relativa por Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Humidade relativa")

ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(clusters), y = depart_pressure, fill = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Distribuição da pressão por Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Pressão")

ggplot(df, aes(x = as.factor(clusters), y = depart_wind_direction, fill = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Distribuição da direção do vento por Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Direção do vento")

# install.packages("scales")
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("ricardo-bion/ggradar")

library(dplyr)
library(scales)
## 
## Attaching package: 'scales'
## The following object is masked from 'package:purrr':
## 
##     discard
## The following object is masked from 'package:readr':
## 
##     col_factor
library(ggradar)

analise_medias <- df %>%
  group_by(clusters) %>%
  summarise(
    Atraso_Partida = mean(delay_depart, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temperatura = mean(depart_air_temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    Umidade_Relativa = mean(depart_relative_humidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Direcao_Vento = mean(depart_wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pressao = mean(depart_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    Visibilidade = mean(depart_visibility, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

medias_normalizadas <- analise_medias %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-clusters), rescale)

ggradar(medias_normalizadas,
        grid.min = 0, grid.mid = 0.5, grid.max = 1,
        axis.label.size = 4,
        legend.title = "Clusters",
        legend.text.size = 10) +
  labs(title = "Perfil dos Clusters de Voo") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

df_numerico <- df %>%
  select(delay_depart, depart_air_temperature, depart_dew_point,
         depart_relative_humidity, depart_wind_direction, depart_pressure,
         depart_visibility, depart_apparent_temperature) %>%
  na.omit()

pca_resultado <- prcomp(df_numerico, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_resultado)
## Importance of components:
##                           PC1    PC2    PC3    PC4    PC5     PC6    PC7
## Standard deviation     1.7616 1.2291 1.0078 1.0000 0.9907 0.59788 0.1470
## Proportion of Variance 0.3879 0.1888 0.1270 0.1250 0.1227 0.04468 0.0027
## Cumulative Proportion  0.3879 0.5767 0.7037 0.8287 0.9514 0.99609 0.9988
##                            PC8
## Standard deviation     0.09840
## Proportion of Variance 0.00121
## Cumulative Proportion  1.00000
df_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_resultado$x[, 1:2]) 

df_pca$clusters <- df %>% pull(clusters)

ggplot(df_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = as.factor(clusters))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  labs(title = "Visualização dos Clusters via PCA",
       x = "Componente Principal 1",
       y = "Componente Principal 2",
       color = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
